title: 第721章 敲打第720章 太阳系我们待不了了
slug: 魔法我钢铁洪流直接平推
lines: 赵老也被震撼的不轻，不过当初就决定了坐着月球离开，现在加上了蓝星，倒也还好。
等众人议论了一会儿，他抬起手。
会议室迅速安静下来。
赵老确定钱振华说完后，看向主管后勤生产的负责人。
那是一个身材微微发福的中年人，眼下有明显黑眼圈。
这一年里，大夏生产任务几乎一天一个台阶。
最开始只是武器装备。
后来是地下城扩建、机器人、无人机、机甲、舰船、月球基地、泰拉工厂、科纳前哨基地。
现在又多了三十六座船坞、重型工程机器人量产、行星发动机全面提速。
所有压力，最后都会压到后勤生产体系上。
见赵老看来，他立刻坐直身体。
“首长，我们后勤生产系统虽然压力很大，但定会尽力配合科学院，把所有研究成果转化为实际产能。”
他说完，自己觉得这话没毛病。
后勤确实已经快被压到极限。
可赵老的眉头，却慢慢皱了起来。
众人都是察言观色的好手，见情况不对，会议室里的空气渐渐变的凝重起来。
赵老没有拍桌，也没有提高音量。
他只是看着那位负责人，缓缓开口。
“尽力？”
两个字一出，对方额头立即冒出冷汗。
赵老把手里的茶杯放下，淡淡道：
“后勤系统压力大，我知道。”
“同志们连轴转，我也知道。”
“但现在不是讲尽力的时候。”
他目光扫过会议室，声音一点点加重。
“我们面前是什么局面？”
“蓝星还在减速，魔族随时可能反扑，科纳前哨基地刚刚站稳，泰拉大陆也没有彻底安全。”
“林默同志、韩猊霸同志，还有我们的战士和科研人员，都是在前面拿命抢时间！”
“他们抢回来一天，后方就必须把这一天用到极致！”
赵老的话，让所有人背脊都不由自主绷紧。
“我不希望看到任何部门，因为阶段性胜利就松一口气。”
“更不希望看到有人觉得，大夏赢了一仗，就可以缓一缓、歇一歇、等一等。”
“现在还没到庆功的时候。”
“前线不能掉链子，后方更不能拖后腿！”
content_en:
Mr. Zhao was also shocked, but he had decided to leave on the moon at the beginning, and now that Blue Star was included, it was okay.
After everyone discussed for a while, he raised his hand.
The conference room quickly fell silent.
After Mr. Zhao was sure that Qian Zhenhua had finished speaking, he looked at the person in charge of logistics and production.
He was a slightly stout middle-aged man with obvious dark circles under his eyes.
During this year, Daxia's production tasks have improved almost every day.
At first it was just weapons and equipment.
Later came dungeon expansions, robots, drones, mechs, ships, moon bases, Terra factories, and Kona outposts.
Now there are thirty-six more shipyards, heavy engineering robots are mass-produced, and planetary engines are fully accelerated.
All pressure will eventually be put on the logistics production system.
When he saw Mr. Zhao, he immediately sat up straight.
"Chief, although our logistics production system is under great pressure, we will do our best to cooperate with the Academy of Sciences and transform all research results into actual production capacity."
After he finished speaking, he felt that there was nothing wrong with what he said.
Logistics is indeed being stretched to the limit.
But Mr. Zhao's brows slowly wrinkled.
Everyone is good at observing words and emotions. Seeing that something was wrong, the air in the conference room gradually became solemn.
Mr. Zhao did not slam the table or raise his voice.
He just looked at the person in charge and spoke slowly.
"Try your best?"
As soon as these two words came out, cold sweat broke out on the other person's forehead.
Mr. Zhao put down the teacup in his hand and said calmly:
"The logistics system is stressful, I know."
"Comrades are spinning their wheels, and I know that."
"But now is not the time to talk about trying your best."
His eyes swept across the conference room, and his voice got louder and louder.
"What situation do we have before us?"
"Blue Star is still slowing down. The demons may counterattack at any time. The Kona outpost has just stood firm, and the continent of Terra is not completely safe."
"Comrade Lin Mo, Comrade Han Yiba, as well as our soldiers and scientific researchers, are all fighting for time at the front!"
"If they take back one day, the rear must make the most of it!"
Mr. Zhao's words made everyone's backs tense up involuntarily.
"I don't want to see any department breathe a sigh of relief because of a stage win."
"I don't want to see anyone think that just because Daxia has won a battle, they can take a break, take a break, and wait."
"It's not time to celebrate yet."
"The frontline must not lose control, and the rear must not hold back!"
title_en: Chapter 721: Beating Chapter 720: We can’t stay in the solar system any longer
